post.title: House hunting is making me feel insane
post.body_preview:
I did not expect this part at all. 

At first it was kind of exciting...
post.top_comment: It gets better, you’ll find a house that’s the perfect fit then close on it and feel like you made the biggest mistake of your life. Only way to stay sane is to learn not to give a fuck, it’s hard though.

answer.description: Buying your first home can be exciting, confusing, and everything in between -- and you don’t have to go through it alone. This community aims to provide a place where members can ask questions, share stories, and celebrate wins! We welcome everyone from window shoppers and house hunters to experienced buyers, hobbyists, and pros. Please review the rules, and use user flair and post flair to keep conversations helpful and on track.
